comment: Quote flow (S-1): Jupiter's sales authority matrix, concession schedule and deal-importance score. Source: Jupiter sales policy v1 (jupiter-sales-policy.json in the data pack, 2026-11-16), the same policy that produced the T01-T08 oracle (services/test/fixtures/quote-expected-outcomes.csv). Prices are US cents per unit, DAP Los Angeles. Margin = (price - landed cost) / price; landed cost comes from JupiterTreasuryAgent in OutcomeAI.
priceUnit: US cents per unit, DAP Los Angeles
concessionComment: Seller ask per round: round 1 at 15%, round 2 at 13.5%, round 3 at the agent floor (minMargin of AGENT).

advanceLever.comment: With a treasury DEFICIT and >= 30% advance, every level may use its minMarginWithAdvance.

treasuryChecks.comment: Checks on JupiterTreasuryAgent's answer. creditOverLimit: credit.ok false (the financed invoice is over the buyer's credit headroom) needs at least minLevel; the agent cannot close it. liquidityDeficit: null = off, because the sales policy handles a DEFICIT with the advance lever only; set { "minLevel": "SALES_OFFICER" } to also escalate a DEFICIT without a >= 30% advance. minLevel null records the reason without raising authority.

splitShipment.comment: A split is offered when at least 70% can be delivered by the deadline; the rest is planned as a second shipment by the latest delivery date (data-pack horizon).

importance.dealSizeComment: Deal size = quantity x target price (15% margin, without reallocation premium).

inputs.status: PLACEHOLDER (snapshot of the data pack 2026-11-16: customers.csv TOMMY = TIER1, policy capacityUtilisationPct = 68). Stands in for live values from OutcomeAI, which the section 4 contract does not serve yet.

escalationComment: An officer level counters at max(floor, ceil((floor + anchor) / 2)); anchor = the agent's last ask (lastAsk) or the round-1 target ask (target). The buyer then accepts, or answers with its best price; a best price at or above the level floor closes at that price.
